training_data: waveshare_work TRAIN scenes (14/17, session-level seeded split, session_train_test_split default seed=0) + the FULL synth_room_1..5 corpus (~31M frame-instances, used wholesale -- synthetic data is never split, per the task-3 instruction). Synthetic labels are frame-level presence only (label_join.classify_event); waveshare labels are real per-frame YOLO class-0 boxes.
input_output: Input: 6-D feature vector [max_temp, mean_temp, std_temp, area, skewness, kurtosis] from Otsu-segmented hottest blob. Output: FireAlert (level, confidence).

onnx_export.scope: StandardScaler + SVC(probability=True) only -- Otsu segmentation and blob feature extraction are classical CV code, not exported.

how_to_load:
from thermal_algorithms.core.checkpoints import CheckpointRegistry
from thermal_algorithms.fire_detection.fire_svm import FireSVMDetector
registry = CheckpointRegistry(root='checkpoints_baseline_waveshare')
det = registry.load(FireSVMDetector, profile_name='Waveshare_26984')
